subject: general
question: In which of the following countries was the 2022 Cricket Asia Cup held?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Option 1**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The 2022 Cricket Asia Cup **was held in **United Arab Emirates.**
 
• "Every effort was made to host the Asia Cup in Sri Lanka and the decision to shift the venue to the UAE was taken after much deliberation," **Asian Cricket Council (ACC) **President **Jay Shah** said that.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Asia Cup** is a **cricket tournament** that features teams from** Asian countries**.
 
• It is organized by the** Asian Cricket Council (ACC),** which is a regional governing body for **cricket in Asia.**
 
• The tournament has been held since **1984**, with the exception of a few years.
 
• The participating teams in the Asia Cup typically include **Test-playing nation**s such as **India, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, and Afghanistan**, along with other Asian countries that qualify through regional tournaments.
